parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, typically cylindrical with a lever for manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle to adjust the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to open or close the water flow, providing smooth manual control.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It connects to the water supply and channels water through the internal valve system to the outlet spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the switch and internal water pathways.
